layers.title: Top copper (F)
layers.what: Charge amplifiers at the blade end, clock, IMU, charger and regulators in the middle, ESP32-S3 module and USB-C at the butt (USB-C) end.

layers.title: Inner 1 (ground)
layers.what: Solid ground plane under the top layer.

layers.title: Inner 2 (signals)
layers.what: Routing layer between the two ground planes.

layers.title: Inner 3 (signals)
layers.what: Routing layer between the two ground planes.

layers.title: Inner 4 (ground)
layers.what: Solid ground plane above the bottom layer.

layers.title: Bottom copper (B)
layers.what: Film connector, the two ADCs and the SD NAND sit on this side; seen here from the top, as if through the board.

parts.label: OPA4376 x 3: eleven charge amplifiers plus the reference buffer
Hirose FH19C-15S: flex connector for the 11 film electrodes
8.192 MHz oscillator shared by both ADCs
BQ24040 Li-ion charger with battery-temperature cut-off
ADS131M08 #2: C4, C5, handle film, LED loop-back, noise reference
TPS7A2030: regulator for the analog supply
TLV757P: regulator for the digital supply
